sections.body: Rising vapor cools with altitude until it condenses on tiny particles, forming cloud droplets. When droplets grow heavy enough, they fall as precipitation. Dew is condensation forming directly on cool surfaces overnight.

record_text:
Key points.
Condensation. Water vapor cools into liquid droplets, forming clouds and dew.

In depth.
Rising vapor cools with altitude until it condenses on tiny particles, forming cloud droplets. When droplets grow heavy enough, they fall as precipitation. Dew is condensation forming directly on cool surfaces overnight.
